title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-11-07

ai_review.summary: Mixed recording with pop glitches but a fierce Dark Star performance
ai_review.review: Reviewers are split; one praises the show, calling Dark Star "fierce," while another finds the recording unlistenable due to repetitive popping noises. The musical highlight is clearly the powerful Dark Star, though the technical flaws detract from overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (especially Dark Star) but recording suffers noticeable pop glitches; weighted average of show (≈4) and recording (≈2) yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: One reviewer reports repetitive popping noises that make the tape hard to listen to; no explicit mention of soundboard or audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; only Dark Star is highlighted.
